pkgmetadata.longdescription: Wazuh is a free, open source and enterprise-ready security monitoring solution for threat detection, integrity monitoring, incident response and compliance.

use.flag:
Install as a high availability multi-node instead of single-node.
Single node (default):
- 6-8 GB RAM - 2-4 cores - 50 GB SSD for real time indexer - For the lab, small orgs, or PoC (Proof of Concept) use - low availability - Easy to setup - Single indexer data lost risk - Overloaded manager possible - Dashboard included
Multi node:
- 16-32 GB RAM - 8 cores - NVMe SSD for real time indexer - For production use, large orgs - More resilient and high availability - Medium or high setup difficulty - Multiple indexer redundunancy - Can distribute the load to workers to prevent single node overload. - Dashboard included - Multiple independent VMs are recommended for true high availability and for resiliency to prevent SEIM going totally offline
